titulo: Me and my friend ending the call
caption:
Me and my friend ending the call

Me and my friend ending the call.

Goodbyes drag because each side adds one more polite line. A clear last one, like talk tomorrow, ends it.

Send it to the friend who never hangs up first.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark room. Two small block figures with white eyes, an amber one on the left and a light blue one on the right. In the very first frame the amber one already says bye! in a speech bubble. They answer each other over and over: bye!!, ok bye, bye bye, talk soon!, yep bye, each with a small pulse. In the last second the amber one says bye! again exactly as in the first frame, so the film repeats without a cut. The text stays: me and my friend ending the call.
